# Cassandra Lee

> Product designer & small business owner who loves prototyping microinteractions and media tools that help influencers capture moments, spark engagement and build online communities. Passions: digital media, product design and brand marketing.

## Selected case studies

- [Today's Daily Prompt: giving BeReal users a reason to post](https://example.com/case-studies/bereal-daily-prompt/): BeReal PM externship, iOS concept. 89% of test users rated the concept clear; 78% would recommend BeReal because of it.
- [UC Davis Mobile App Redesign](https://example.com/case-studies/uc-davis-mobile-redesign/): Davis Design Interactive Fellowship, team of 4. Designed the Community and Clubs & Organizations pages for a 2-star campus app.

## Design for play

Design workflows, not just UI. Optimise the most-used tasks. Ship the smallest valuable thing. Reuse before you reinvent. An edge case is a use case.

## Skills

Product design, interaction design, prototyping, design systems, accessibility (WCAG 2.2), user research, experimentation.
